question: Are risky manual formatting commands avoided in TeX sources?
rule_definition: Manual layout override commands such as \vspace, \setlength, and page style commands should be avoided unless explicitly justified.
remediation: Remove or minimize manual formatting overrides and rely on template-driven structure.
notes: Covers a broad risky-command allowlist.

question: Are label identifiers unique?
rule_definition: Each \label{...} value must be unique across the project.
remediation: Rename duplicate labels and update references accordingly.
notes: Duplicate labels produce FAIL findings.

question: Do label identifiers avoid whitespace?
rule_definition: Labels should not contain spaces to avoid brittle references and style inconsistency.
remediation: Replace spaces with separators like colon or underscore.
notes: Whitespace in labels is flagged as WARNING.

question: Do \ref/\eqref targets resolve to existing labels?
rule_definition: All detected \ref{...} and \eqref{...} commands should map to defined labels.
remediation: Add missing labels or correct reference keys.
notes: Undefined references are currently heuristic for simple forms.

question: Do figure/table environments include captions?
rule_definition: Each figure and table environment should define \caption{...}.
remediation: Add meaningful captions to all figures and tables.
notes: Missing captions are detected in simple environment parsing.

question: Do figure/table environments include labels?
rule_definition: Each figure and table environment should define \label{...}.
remediation: Add labels for cross-referencing and consistency.
notes: Missing labels are detected per environment block.

question: Do captions end with terminal punctuation?
rule_definition: Caption text should end with punctuation (., !, or ?).
remediation: Edit captions to end with terminal punctuation.
notes: Punctuation check is heuristic and style-oriented.

question: Are key front-matter and structure commands present?
rule_definition: Project should include abstract, TOC, lists of tables/figures, chapters, and bibliography commands.
remediation: Add missing structure commands/environments required by the template.
notes: Presence-based check only; does not validate rendered layout.

question: Do optional ChkTeX warnings indicate source issues worth addressing?
rule_definition: When available locally, ChkTeX warnings can highlight TeX source style and syntax risks.
remediation: Review ChkTeX warnings and adjust LaTeX source where appropriate.
notes: Optional check; skipped gracefully when ChkTeX is not installed.

question: Do optional lacheck warnings indicate source issues worth addressing?
rule_definition: When available locally, lacheck warnings can highlight LaTeX source problems.
remediation: Review lacheck warnings and adjust LaTeX source where appropriate.
notes: Optional check; skipped gracefully when lacheck is not installed.

question: Is there possible text outside required margins?
rule_definition: Detect text blocks outside assumed margin bounds (left 1.5in, right/top/bottom 1.0in).
remediation: Review block positions and adjust document margins/layout as needed.
notes: Heuristic foundation check; excludes likely page-number candidates.

question: Does the PDF contain annotations/comments?
rule_definition: Detect reviewer comments/annotations embedded in the PDF file.
remediation: Resolve or remove annotations before final submission.
notes: Best-effort extraction from PDF annotation objects.

question: Are there page-number candidates near top/bottom zones?
rule_definition: Detect numeric/roman page-number-like text in top/bottom margin zones for manual rule review.
remediation: Verify page-number visibility/placement against NJIT requirements.
notes: Candidate detection only; not full NJIT page-number compliance.

question: Do named front-matter headings follow expected layout/style heuristics?
rule_definition: Detect expected named front-matter headings and warn if they are not near top, centered, bold, and all caps.
remediation: Center named front-matter headings near the top of the page and format as bold all caps.
notes: Named heading checks only; does not require every optional front-matter section.

question: Do front-matter/body paragraphs show likely indentation issues?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect strong paragraph indentation anomalies in PDF text lines, including unexpected opening indents and likely missing later first-line indents.
remediation: Use consistent first-line indentation in paragraph text and remove unintended opening-paragraph indents.
notes: Conservative heuristic; ignores heading lines, page numbers, and TOC/list pages.

question: Are there likely excessive spacing or blank-line issues in PDF text layout?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect strong blank-line and vertical-spacing anomalies from extracted text-line geometry.
remediation: Reduce unintended blank lines and excessive vertical gaps, especially around front-matter headings and paragraph transitions.
notes: Conservative heuristic; focuses on strong gap signals and groups repeated page-level warnings.

question: Do figure/table caption and title lines show obvious formatting issues?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect obvious punctuation and high-confidence case-style anomalies in visible figure/table caption-like PDF lines.
remediation: Review figure/table caption and list-entry punctuation/case formatting for consistency with thesis guidelines.
notes: Conservative caption-line heuristic; warns only on strong visible text-layer signals.

question: Do TOC/List of Tables/List of Figures entries show likely alignment inconsistencies?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect obvious TOC/list entry alignment issues including page-number column alignment, missing page numbers, leader-dot inconsistency, and indentation outliers.
remediation: Align TOC/list entry page-number columns, maintain consistent leader-dot usage, and fix missing page numbers or obvious indentation outliers.
notes: Conservative TOC/list-page heuristic; runs only on named TOC/list heading pages.

question: Do page-number candidates show obvious sequence, style, or position inconsistencies?
rule_definition: Heuristically validate obvious page-number sequence/style issues using detected page-number candidates across pages.
remediation: Review page-number visibility, position, style consistency, and sequence continuity.
notes: Conservative candidate-based sequence/style check; does not yet enforce full NJIT policy.

question: Do title-like PDF lines follow NJIT title-case capitalization heuristics?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect obvious title-case violations in title-like PDF text regions. Per NJIT guidelines, Level 2 headings (X.x) and table titles use Title Case: each word capitalized except short articles, prepositions, and conjunctions. Checked for bold heading-like lines and table caption title bodies. Not applied to body paragraphs, figure captions (sentence case), Level 3+ headings (sentence case), references pages, or all-caps front-matter labels.
remediation: Review flagged title-like lines for NJIT title case: capitalize the first word, last word, all major words (4+ letters), and all words after subtitle separators. Short articles (a, an, the), conjunctions (and, but, or, for, nor, as), and prepositions (at, by, in, of, on, per, to, up, via) may remain lowercase in the middle.
notes: Conservative heuristic; applies only to bold headings and table titles. Preserves all-caps acronyms (PDF, AI, NJIT). Skips hyphenated words and math tokens. Sources: data/raw/guidelines/Titles Examples Level 1 to 5.docx; data/raw/guidelines/Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx.

question: Does the abstract exceed the NJIT word-count limit for the detected degree type?
rule_definition: PhD abstract maximum: 350 words. MS/Master abstract maximum: 150 words. Degree type is inferred from source text (LaTeX) or PDF text layer. Word count uses conservative tokenization (letter-containing tokens only). Implemented for both LaTeX source and compiled PDF.
remediation: Shorten the abstract to within the applicable limit. PhD: ≤350 words. MS: ≤150 words.
notes: LaTeX-side: degree type inferred from source; counts words after LaTeX stripping. PDF-side (pdf_abstract.py): single-page abstract extraction, conservative PhD threshold when type unknown. Source: data/raw/guidelines/Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx.

section: PDF front-matter no visible page number
question: Do any named no-number front-matter pages (Abstract, Title, Approval, Copyright) show a visible page number?
rule_definition: NJIT requires no visible page number on the Abstract page (Q001), Title page (Q008), Approval page (Q014), and Copyright page (Q012). This rule detects page-number-like candidates (numeric or Roman numeral tokens) in the top/bottom margin zone on these specific named pages and emits one warning per affected page. Years (1900-2099) in the title-page zone are suppressed to avoid false positives. Copyright page detection is conservative: only flagged when clear copyright signals are found in the first four pages.
remediation: Remove any visible page number from the Abstract, Title, Approval, or Copyright page. These pages must not display a page number per NJIT formatting guidelines.
notes: Conservative heuristic. Sources: Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx; Front Matter Pages Lorem Ipsum.pdf. Partially addresses Q001 (Abstract), Q008 (Title), Q012 (Copyright), Q014 (Approval). Reuses P013-style candidate detection but targets only identified no-number pages. Title-page detection uses first-page heuristic when document has front-matter headings and >= 3 pages. Does not duplicate P013 (global candidates) or P019 (sequence). issue_type: visible_page_number_on_no_number_page. page_type values: abstract, title_page, approval_page, copyright_page.

question: Does any body-text page show line spacing that appears to be less than double-spaced?
rule_definition: Body text paragraphs must be double-spaced (line spacing ≥ ~1.8–2.4× font size). This rule measures the median top-of-bbox-to-top-of-bbox distance between consecutive body-text lines and flags pages where the median ratio is below 1.55× the estimated body font size. TOC, list, and references pages are excluded. Heading, caption, page-number, bullet, and short lines are excluded per page. Minimum 5 body lines and 3 suspicious gaps required before a warning is emitted.
remediation: Set body text to double line spacing. In LaTeX: use \doublespacing or \setstretch{2.0}. In Word: set paragraph line spacing to 'Double'.
notes: Conservative heuristic. Guideline basis: Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx (body text must be double-spaced); Self-Self Assessment Sheet.pdf (double-spacing checklist item). Threshold 1.55× is between single (≈1.1–1.3×) and double (≈2.0–2.3×) spacing at 12pt. One finding per affected page. Paragraph-break gaps (ratio > 4.0×) are excluded from spacing analysis.

section: PDF TOC and list entry formatting
question: Do TOC/LoT/LoF entries follow expected capitalization and punctuation style?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect obvious capitalization and punctuation issues in TABLE OF CONTENTS, LIST OF TABLES, and LIST OF FIGURES entry lines. TOC Level 1 entries should be ALL CAPS (Q049); TOC Level 2 entries should be Title Case (Q050); List of Tables titles should use Title Case and not end with a period; List of Figures descriptions should use sentence case.
remediation: Review flagged TOC/LoT/LoF entries for NJIT capitalization requirements: Level 1=ALL CAPS, Level 2=Title Case, List of Tables=Title Case (no terminal period), List of Figures=sentence case.
notes: Conservative heuristic. Sources: Titles Examples Level 1 to 5.docx (L1=ALL CAPS, L2=Title Case); Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx. TOC level classified by numbering pattern (1.1, 1.1.1, CHAPTER) and indentation clusters. Skips ambiguous entries, short entries, and entries without enough words. issue_type values: toc_level_capitalization, list_of_tables_title_case, list_of_figures_sentence_case, unexpected_terminal_punctuation.

question: Do required front-matter pages contain expected structural elements?
rule_definition: Heuristically detect missing or sparse required elements in front-matter pages: (A) Abstract page has body text; (B) early pages contain a degree phrase and institution name; (C) Approval page has non-sparse body content; (D) Abstract appears before Table of Contents.
remediation: Ensure the Abstract page has body text, the title page includes the degree and institution name, the Approval page contains committee/signature content, and front-matter pages appear in the required order.
notes: Conservative heuristic. Sources: Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx; Front Matter Pages Lorem Ipsum.pdf; PhD Title Pages.pdf. Does not duplicate P014 (heading style) or P021 (abstract word count). Title page check guarded by presence of named front-matter headings and minimum page count. issue_type values: missing_abstract_body, missing_title_page_degree_phrase, missing_title_page_institution, sparse_approval_page_content, possible_frontmatter_order_issue.

question: Does the body text use Times New Roman 12pt (or an accepted equivalent)?
rule_definition: NJIT guidelines require body text to use Times New Roman 12pt throughout. This rule checks ordinary body-text spans on each page for (A) font size outside 11.0-13.0pt and (B) font family that is not Times New Roman or an accepted near-equivalent (NimbusRomNo9L, TeX Gyre Termes, Liberation Serif, FreeSerif, STIX). Computer Modern (CMR, LaTeX default) is flagged as likely non-Times. Embedded subset font-name prefixes (e.g. ABCDEF+TimesNewRomanPSMT) are stripped before classification. One finding per (page, issue_type). Warnings emitted only when both violation count >=5 AND fraction >=50% of body candidate spans on the page.
remediation: Set body text to Times New Roman 12pt throughout. LaTeX: use mathptmx or a Times-based font package. Word/LibreOffice: set paragraph font to Times New Roman, size 12.
notes: Heuristic. Sources: Thesis and Dissertation Formatting Guidelines (WIP).docx; Self-Self Assessment Sheet.pdf. Excludes named front-matter pages, TOC/list pages, references pages. Excludes margin zones, headings, captions, bullets, short lines, and low-alpha-density lines. Accepted font aliases: Times, NimbusRomNo9L, TeX Gyre Termes, Liberation Serif, FreeSerif, STIX. issue_type values: possible_body_font_size_issue, possible_body_font_family_issue. Note: Computer Modern (CMR12, the LaTeX default) will be flagged. EF evaluation: all 4 tested PDFs use CMR12 or Georgia -- expect P026 family warnings on all.

question: Do numbered headings follow the expected level-specific capitalization and punctuation style?
rule_definition: Numbered section headings (1.1, 1.1.1, etc.) should follow NJIT level-specific style: Level 2 = Title Case; Level 3 = Sentence case; Level 4/5 = Sentence case ending with a period. Body-chapter headings (CHAPTER N TITLE) should be ALL CAPS. Inferred from section-number pattern; conservative: only flags clear violations with >=2 non-first capitalized major words for sentence-case checks.
remediation: Ensure numbered section headings follow the correct capitalization style for their level: Level 2 (1.x): Title Case; Level 3 (1.x.x): Sentence case (bold); Level 4 (1.x.x.x) and Level 5 (1.x.x.x.x): Sentence case ending with a period.
notes: Heuristic. Source: Titles Examples Level 1 to 5.docx. Q-rule basis: Q051 (Level 3 sentence case). Does not duplicate P014 (named front-matter heading style), P020 (bold-line title-case), or P024 (TOC/List entry capitalization). Level inferred from numbered pattern. issue_type values: level1_not_all_caps, level2_title_case_issue, level3_sentence_case_issue, level4_sentence_case_or_punctuation_issue, level5_sentence_case_or_punctuation_issue.

question: Do front-matter numbered pages use lowercase Roman numerals and body pages use Arabic numerals?
rule_definition: NJIT requires front-matter pages that show page numbers to use lowercase Roman numerals (i, ii, iii, ...) and main-body pages to use Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3, ...). This rule detects the front-matter and body regions from named headings and chapter/body heading detection, then checks that P013-style page-number candidates match the expected style for their region. No-number pages (ABSTRACT, APPROVAL PAGE, title page) are excluded; P022 handles those.
remediation: Use lowercase Roman numerals (i, ii, iii) for front-matter numbered pages and Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3) for body pages. Configure page numbering in LaTeX using \frontmatter/\mainmatter commands or \pagenumbering{roman}/\pagenumbering{arabic}.
notes: Heuristic. Q-rule basis: Q022, Q031, Q035, Q046, Q060. Does not duplicate P013 (global candidates), P019 (sequence/style), or P022 (no-number pages). Region classification uses named front-matter headings + CHAPTER/APPENDIX heading detection. issue_type values: arabic_number_on_frontmatter_page, uppercase_roman_on_frontmatter_page, roman_number_on_body_page. One finding per (page, issue_type).

question: Do visible lowercase Roman numerals in front-matter appear in a continuous increasing sequence (i, ii, iii…)?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic that validates ordering of visible lowercase Roman numeral page numbers on front-matter pages. Flags repeated, decreasing, or skipped Roman numerals across consecutive visible numbered front-matter pages. Skips explicitly identified no-number pages and ambiguous region classifications.
remediation: Verify and correct front-matter Roman numeral ordering so visible page numbers form a continuous ascending sequence (i, ii, iii, …).
notes: Conservative heuristic. Reuses page-number candidate detection and front-matter region classification. issue_type values: roman_sequence_gap, roman_sequence_repeat, roman_sequence_decrease, roman_sequence_unexpected_start. One finding per (page, issue_type).

question: Do multi-page Table of Contents, List of Tables, or List of Figures sections use a continued heading on subsequent pages?
rule_definition: When a TOC, List of Tables, or List of Figures section spans more than one consecutive page, each continuation page should display a continued heading such as "TABLE OF CONTENTS (Continued)", "LIST OF TABLES (Continued)", or "LIST OF FIGURES (Continued)". This conservative heuristic flags only consecutive continuation pages of the same section that lack a continued-heading variant.
remediation: Add the appropriate continued heading to each continuation page of the multi-page TOC, List of Tables, or List of Figures section.
notes: Conservative heuristic partial coverage for Q048, Q062, and Q071. Reuses TOC/List page detection from pdf_toc_alignment.py. Does not verify bold/centering of continued headings. Skips single-page sections and non-consecutive pages. issue_type: missing_continued_heading.

question: Do List of Tables and List of Figures pages show expected Table/Figure and Page column header labels in the expected coarse regions?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic that checks List of Tables and List of Figures pages for short header-row labels: left label (Table or Figure) near the entry column and Page near the page-number column. Flags only clearly missing labels or labels far from expected coarse regions. Does not apply to Table of Contents pages.
remediation: Add bold left-aligned Table/Figure and right-aligned Page column header labels directly under the list heading on each List of Tables or List of Figures page.
notes: Conservative partial PDF heuristic for Q063, Q064, Q072, Q073. Does not verify bold styling or exact alignment. Skips ambiguous pages and pages without extractable list entries. issue_type values: missing_left_column_header, missing_page_column_header, left_column_header_misaligned, page_column_header_misaligned.

question: Do wrapped Table of Contents, List of Tables, and List of Figures entries appear internally single-spaced between the first line and continuation line?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic that flags likely wrapped TOC/List entries where the vertical gap between the first line and its continuation line clearly exceeds single-spacing relative to local line height or font size. Applies to Table of Contents, List of Tables, and List of Figures pages. Skips ambiguous entry grouping and spacing between separate entries.
remediation: Adjust wrapped TOC/List entry formatting so continuation lines sit on the next single-spaced line within the same entry, rather than with extra internal blank space.
notes: Conservative partial PDF heuristic for Q053-Q055, Q066-Q067, and Q076-Q078. Does not verify full visual compliance, leader dots, or spacing between separate entries. Skips ambiguous continuation grouping. issue_type: wrapped_entry_internal_spacing.

question: Is the dissertation title consistent across the Title Page, Abstract page, and Approval Page?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic that compares normalized title-like text extracted from the Title Page, Abstract page (above the ABSTRACT heading), and Approval Page (above the APPROVAL PAGE heading). Flags only material differences after normalization; skips ambiguous, image-only, or single-candidate cases.
remediation: Ensure the dissertation title matches exactly on the Title Page, Abstract page, and Approval Page (allowing only line breaks and minor punctuation or case differences).
notes: Partial PDF heuristic for cross-page title consistency (documented remaining gap; front-matter/title-page guideline sources). Does not quote title text in findings. Uses normalized text hashes and similarity scores only. issue_type: frontmatter_title_mismatch.

section: PDF Copyright Page metadata and layout
question: Does the Copyright Page avoid top-margin header text and match the Title Page copyright year and author name when confidently extractable?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic on a confidently identified Copyright Page: flags visible non-page-number text in the top margin (Q009); compares copyright year to Title Page graduation year (Q010) and author name to Title Page author after 'by' (Q011) only when both sides are confidently extracted. Skips ambiguous, image-only, or undetected copyright pages. Does not quote author names or title text in findings.
remediation: Remove running headers from the Copyright Page top margin; ensure the copyright notice year and author match the Title Page graduation year and author name.
notes: Partial PDF heuristic for Q009-Q011. Does not replace manual copyright-page or administrative approval checks. Does not duplicate Q012 (no page number) covered by P022. issue_types: copyright_top_margin_header_text, copyright_year_mismatch, copyright_author_mismatch.

question: Do body-page figure/table floats appear centered with captions in the expected position?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic on body pages: infer adjacent text-layer figure/table body blocks near detected Figure N / Table N captions; flag horizontal centering drift from the text-area center and caption placement violations (table caption above body, figure caption below body). Skips image-only floats, TOC/LoF/LoT/references pages, and ambiguous multi-block pages.
remediation: Center figure/table body blocks within the text area; place table captions above the table body and figure captions below the figure body per NJIT formatting guidance.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Self-Assessment figure/table centering and caption placement. Reuses caption detection from pdf_captions.py. Skips image-only floats and non-text-layer bodies. issue_types: table_body_not_centered, figure_body_not_centered, table_caption_not_above_body, figure_caption_not_below_body.

question: Do consecutive TOC, List of Tables, and List of Figures entries have visible double spacing between them?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic on detected TOC/LoT/LoF pages: group text-layer lines into distinct entries (skipping wrapped internal continuations handled by P032), measure vertical gap between consecutive entries, and flag when gap is below a conservative double-spacing threshold. Skips ambiguous/sparse pages and does not quote entry title text.
remediation: Add visible double spacing or a blank line between consecutive TOC, List of Tables, or List of Figures entries per NJIT formatting guidance.
notes: Partial PDF heuristic for Q057, Q067, Q077. Complements P032 wrapped internal spacing; excludes P018/P024/P030/P031 checks. issue_types: toc_inter_entry_spacing_too_tight, lot_inter_entry_spacing_too_tight, lof_inter_entry_spacing_too_tight.

question: Do BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH, DEDICATION, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, TABLE OF CONTENTS, and LIST OF TABLES pages carry the expected lowercase Roman numerals per the NJIT template (bio=iv, ded=v, ack=vi, toc=vii, lot=viii)?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic anchored on the detected BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH page: requires visible Roman numeral iv (4) on that page. Subsequent sections (DEDICATION, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, TABLE OF CONTENTS, LIST OF TABLES) are checked against fixed NJIT template expected values. DEDICATION is optional — if the heading is absent, the slot is still counted (page v may exist as an unnumbered dedication or blank). Emits nothing when BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH heading is not detected. Skips pages with no confident roman_lower candidate. Does not duplicate P028 regime checks or P029 relative sequence checks.
remediation: Ensure BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH appears on the page numbered iv; DEDICATION (if present) on v; ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS on vi; TABLE OF CONTENTS on vii; LIST OF TABLES on viii, per NJIT front-matter pagination template.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q022, Q031, Q035, Q046, Q060. Fixed NJIT template values: bio=4(iv), ded=5(v), ack=6(vi), toc=7(vii), lot=8(viii). Emits nothing if BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH heading absent. Skips sections with no confident roman_lower candidate. issue_types: roman_bio_sketch_not_iv, roman_section_wrong_value.

question: Do required front-matter section headings (APPROVAL PAGE, BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, TABLE OF CONTENTS) appear with their exact canonical phrase, and are they present at all?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: (1) flags required_heading_missing when APPROVAL PAGE, BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, or TABLE OF CONTENTS is not detected in the front-matter region; (2) flags heading_phrase_not_exact when a known curated spelling variant (e.g. ACKNOWLEDGMENTS) is found instead of the canonical NJIT phrase. Gated: no findings if no headings at all are detected (flattened/image-only PDFs). Optional sections (DEDICATION, LIST OF TABLES, LIST OF FIGURES) are not flagged as missing. Does not duplicate P014 style checks (bold/centered/near-top/all-caps) or P025 structure checks.
remediation: Ensure all required front-matter headings use the exact canonical NJIT phrase (ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS not ACKNOWLEDGMENTS, etc.) and that every required section is present.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q013, Q021, Q036, Q047, Q061, Q070. Required headings: APPROVAL PAGE, BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, TABLE OF CONTENTS. Known variant: ACKNOWLEDGMENTS. Gate: skip if no headings detected (flattened PDFs). Optional sections (DEDICATION, LIST OF TABLES, LIST OF FIGURES) not flagged as missing. issue_types: required_heading_missing, heading_phrase_not_exact.

question: Are level-2 and level-3 TOC entries indented to show hierarchy relative to their parent level?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: classifies TOC entry lines as L1 (Chapter/Appendix-pattern entries), L2 (X.Y numbered entries), or L3 (X.Y.Z numbered entries) using text patterns. For each TABLE OF CONTENTS page with both parent-level and child-level entries, checks that the median indent_x of child entries exceeds the median indent_x of parent entries by at least MIN_HIERARCHY_INDENT_PT (6pt). Gate: requires at least 2 child-level entries before checking; skips pages with too few total entries. TOC-only: LoT and LoF pages are not checked. Does not duplicate P024 capitalization checks, P018 alignment checks, P032 wrapped-entry spacing, or P036 inter-entry spacing.
remediation: Ensure TOC level-2 section entries are horizontally indented to the right of level-1 chapter entries, and level-3 subsection entries are further indented relative to level-2 entries.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q056. Level classification uses CHAPTER/APPENDIX prefix patterns for L1 and X.Y / X.Y.Z numeric-section patterns for L2/L3. Minimum indent delta: 6pt. Gate: requires >=2 child-level entries before flagging. Skips LoT/LoF pages. issue_types: toc_l2_not_indented_relative_to_l1, toc_l3_not_indented_relative_to_l2.

section: PDF List of Figures terminal punctuation
question: Does every List of Figures entry (figure description) end with a terminal punctuation mark?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: identifies complete List of Figures entry lines (those with a detected page-number token) and checks that the figure description text, after stripping the Figure N. prefix, leader dots, and page-number token, ends with a terminal punctuation mark (period, question mark, or exclamation point). Skips wrap-continuation lines (no page-number token), lines shorter than 10 characters, and non-LoF pages (TOC and LoT excluded). Emits one finding per offending entry. Findings contain only geometric/count metadata — no figure description text.
remediation: Ensure every figure description in the List of Figures ends with a terminal punctuation mark (period, question mark, or exclamation point).
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q075. Checks only complete LoF entries (page_number_token present). Skips wrap-continuation lines and short entries. LoF-only: TOC and LoT pages excluded. Complements P024 LoF sentence-case check. issue_types: lof_entry_missing_terminal_punctuation.

question: Is there no header text in the top margin area of the Dedication page?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects the Dedication page by scanning the first _MAX_SCAN_PAGES (15) front-matter pages for a line whose normalized text equals "DEDICATION". If found, scans the top 15% of that page for text lines that are not page-number candidates, not the DEDICATION heading itself, and not whitespace/non-alphabetic. Emits at most one finding per Dedication page. Skips if no Dedication page is detected (optional section). Findings contain geometry/classification metadata only — no dedication content.
remediation: Ensure the Dedication page does not have any running header or header text in the top margin area.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q032. Gate: skip if no DEDICATION heading detected in first 15 pages. Top zone: top 15% of page height. Skips page numbers and the DEDICATION heading itself. At most one finding per page. Dedication content (Q033/Q034) not checked. issue_types: dedication_top_margin_header_text.

question: Are appendix entries in the Table of Contents formatted correctly — single appendix with a title, multiple appendices each identified by a letter?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects appendix entries on TABLE OF CONTENTS pages by matching lines whose cleaned text starts with "appendix" (case-insensitive). Single-appendix check (Q058): if exactly one appendix entry is found, verifies that there is title text after the word APPENDIX. Multiple-appendix check (Q059): if two or more are found, verifies each matches the pattern "APPENDIX <single uppercase letter>" immediately after APPENDIX. Skips LoT and LoF pages. Does not include TOC entry text in findings.
remediation: Ensure a single appendix TOC entry reads "APPENDIX" plus the appendix title. Ensure multiple appendix entries each use a letter identifier: "APPENDIX A", "APPENDIX B", etc.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q058 and Q059. TOC-only: LoT/LoF excluded. Appendix detection uses _APPENDIX_RE on entry cleaned_text. issue_types: single_appendix_missing_title (Q058), multiple_appendix_missing_letter (Q059). No TOC entry text in findings.

question: Does the Acknowledgements page follow the correct paragraph indentation style — first paragraph flush-left, subsequent paragraphs indented?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects the ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS page via find_named_frontmatter_headings. Extracts body text lines below the heading, groups them into paragraph blocks by vertical gap, and derives the local left text margin from the minimum x0 across all body lines. Checks: (Q044) the first paragraph block first line is flush-left (x0 within INDENT_THRESHOLD_PT of left_margin); (Q045) each subsequent paragraph block first line is indented (x0 > left_margin + INDENT_THRESHOLD_PT). Gate: skip if ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS page not detected or fewer than 2 paragraph blocks found. Complements P015 (general indentation), which may miss short Acknowledgements pages due to conservative thresholds. Findings contain only geometry metadata — no paragraph text.
remediation: Ensure the first paragraph on the Acknowledgements page begins flush with the left margin, and all subsequent paragraphs begin with a visible indent.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q044 and Q045. Page targeted: ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS only (ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS is in EXPECTED_HEADINGS). Gate: requires >=2 paragraph blocks. Left margin derived from min body-line x0. INDENT_THRESHOLD_PT=18.0. Complements P015; does not replace it. issue_types: acknowledgements_first_paragraph_indented (Q044), acknowledgements_subsequent_paragraph_not_indented (Q045).

question: Does the Abstract page follow the correct paragraph indentation style — first paragraph flush-left, subsequent paragraphs indented?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects the ABSTRACT page via find_named_frontmatter_headings. Extracts body text lines below the heading, groups them into paragraph blocks by vertical gap, and derives the local left text margin from the minimum x0 across all body lines. Checks: (Q002) the first paragraph block first line is flush-left (x0 within INDENT_THRESHOLD_PT of left_margin); (Q003) each subsequent paragraph block first line is indented (x0 > left_margin + INDENT_THRESHOLD_PT). Gate: skip if ABSTRACT page not detected; skip Q003 if fewer than 2 paragraph blocks found. Complements P015 (general indentation), which partially covers abstract opening but not subsequent paragraphs. Findings contain only geometry metadata — no paragraph text.
remediation: Ensure the first paragraph on the Abstract page begins flush with the left margin, and all subsequent paragraphs begin with a visible indent.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q002 and Q003. Page targeted: ABSTRACT only (ABSTRACT is in EXPECTED_HEADINGS). Gate: Q002 requires >=1 paragraph block; Q003 requires >=2 paragraph blocks. Left margin derived from min body-line x0. INDENT_THRESHOLD_PT=18.0. Complements P015 and P043; does not replace them. issue_types: abstract_first_paragraph_indented (Q002), abstract_subsequent_paragraph_not_indented (Q003).

section: PDF Biographical Sketch publication paragraph layout
question: Does the Biographical Sketch page follow the correct publication entry layout — hanging indent for all publication entries, single-spaced entries with a blank line between them, and single-spaced wrapped lines within each entry?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects the BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH page via find_named_frontmatter_headings. Groups text lines below the heading into paragraph blocks. For multi-line blocks with hanging-indent pattern (continuation lines x0 > first line x0 by HANGING_THRESHOLD_PT=12pt), checks: (Q029) if no blocks have hanging indent despite >=2 multi-line blocks, emits missing_hanging_indent; (Q028) if consecutive hanging-indent blocks have inter-block gap < ENTRY_GAP_THRESHOLD_PT=20pt, emits entry_spacing_not_double; (Q026) if a hanging-indent block has internal line gap > MAX_WITHIN_ENTRY_GAP_PT=16pt, emits wrapped_line_spacing_not_single. Gate: skip if BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH heading absent or fewer than 2 multi-line blocks. Findings are geometry-only — no publication text, citation content, or names.
remediation: Ensure all publication/presentation entries on the Biographical Sketch page use hanging indentation, are single-spaced internally, and have a blank line between entries.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q026, Q028, and Q029. Page targeted: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH only. Gate: requires >=2 multi-line blocks. HANGING_THRESHOLD_PT=12.0, ENTRY_GAP_THRESHOLD_PT=20.0, MAX_WITHIN_ENTRY_GAP_PT=16.0. Does not read or quote publication text. issue_types: biosketch_publication_missing_hanging_indent (Q029), biosketch_publication_entry_spacing_not_double (Q028), biosketch_publication_wrapped_line_spacing_not_single (Q026).

section: PDF LoT/LoF entry number left-column alignment
question: Are all table numbers and figure numbers aligned vertically in a consistent left column in the List of Tables and List of Figures respectively?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects List of Tables and List of Figures pages via detect_toc_like_pages. Extracts entry lines via extract_toc_entry_lines, preferring entries with detected page numbers (complete entries). Collects indent_x (x0 position) for each entry. If fewer than MIN_ENTRIES=3 entries are found, skips the section. If the x0 range (max-min) across all entries exceeds X0_RANGE_THRESHOLD_PT=6.0pt, emits a section-level finding. Complements P018 (page-number right-column) and P031 (column-label presence). Findings contain geometry metadata only — no entry text, table/figure titles, or captions.
remediation: Ensure all table numbers in the List of Tables and all figure numbers in the List of Figures are vertically aligned at the same left margin.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q068 and Q078. Sections: list_of_tables, list_of_figures. Gate: requires >=3 entries per section. X0_RANGE_THRESHOLD_PT=6.0. Uses detect_toc_like_pages + extract_toc_entry_lines from pdf_toc_alignment.py. issue_types: lot_entry_number_column_misaligned (Q068), lof_entry_number_column_misaligned (Q078). Complements P018 and P031.

section: PDF Biographical Sketch bullet section single-spacing
question: Are the bullet items in the education section of the Biographical Sketch single-spaced within each bullet?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects the BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH page via find_named_frontmatter_headings. Groups text lines below the heading into paragraph blocks using MAX_PARA_GAP_PT=20pt so wrapped or double-spaced lines remain in one candidate block. Identifies 'bullet' blocks as multi-line blocks that do NOT have hanging-indent (rest_x0 - first_x0 < HANGING_THRESHOLD_PT=12pt). For bullet blocks with >=3 lines, checks internal line gaps using BULLET_MAX_GAP_PT=12pt so distinct bullet/list entries remain separated from within-entry spacing checks. If any gap > BULLET_MAX_GAP_PT, emits biosketch_bullet_section_not_single_spaced. Gate: skip if BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH heading absent or fewer than MIN_BULLET_BLOCKS=2 non-hanging-indent multi-line blocks. Findings are geometry-only — no bullet text, education content, names, or institutions.
remediation: Ensure bullet items in the Biographical Sketch education section are single-spaced within each bullet, with no extra blank lines within a bullet item.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q026. Page targeted: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH only. Gate: requires >=2 non-hanging-indent multi-line blocks and >=3 lines per checked block. HANGING_THRESHOLD_PT=12.0, BULLET_MAX_GAP_PT=12.0, MAX_PARA_GAP_PT=20.0. Complements P045 (hanging-indent publication blocks). Does not read bullet text. issue_type: biosketch_bullet_section_not_single_spaced (Q026).

question: Are all List of Tables and List of Figures page numbers aligned vertically in a consistent right column?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects List of Tables and List of Figures pages via detect_toc_like_pages. Extracts complete entry lines via extract_toc_entry_lines, using detected page-number token right edges. If fewer than MIN_ENTRIES=3 complete entries are found, skips the section. If any page-number right edge differs from the section median by more than RIGHT_EDGE_TOLERANCE_PT=10.0pt, emits a section-level finding. Complements P018 (generic TOC/List alignment), P031 (column labels), and P046 (entry-number left column). Findings contain geometry metadata only — no entry text, table/figure titles, captions, or page-number-adjacent text.
remediation: Ensure all page numbers in the List of Tables and List of Figures are vertically aligned in one consistent right column.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q069 and Q079. Sections: list_of_tables, list_of_figures. Gate: requires >=3 complete entries per section with detected page-number right edges. RIGHT_EDGE_TOLERANCE_PT=10.0. Uses detect_toc_like_pages + extract_toc_entry_lines from pdf_toc_alignment.py. issue_types: lot_page_number_column_misaligned (Q069), lof_page_number_column_misaligned (Q079). Complements P018, P031, and P046.

question: Is the 'Page' column header in the List of Tables and List of Figures right-aligned with the page-number column and formatted in bold?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects LoT/LoF pages via detect_toc_like_pages. Requires MIN_COMPLETE_ENTRIES=3 entries with confident page-number right-x geometry. Derives expected right-column anchor from the median of entry page_number_right_x values. Locates the 'Page' header label in the P031 header zone. If the header's right edge (x1) deviates from the anchor by more than RIGHT_ALIGNMENT_TOLERANCE_PT=25.0pt, emits a right-alignment finding. If all header spans expose reliable non-bold font metadata, emits a bold-style finding. Skips pages without a detected 'Page' header (handled by P031). Findings contain geometry and style metadata only — no entry text, captions, titles, or private content.
remediation: Ensure the 'Page' column header in the List of Tables and List of Figures is bold and right-aligned over the page-number column.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q064 and Q073. Sections: list_of_tables, list_of_figures. Gate: requires >=3 complete entries with page_number_right_x. RIGHT_ALIGNMENT_TOLERANCE_PT=25.0. Uses detect_toc_like_pages, extract_toc_entry_lines, and P031 header-zone helpers. issue_types: lot_page_header_not_right_aligned (Q064), lof_page_header_not_right_aligned (Q073), lot_page_header_not_bold (Q064), lof_page_header_not_bold (Q073). Bold check skipped when font metadata unreliable. Complements P031, P046, P048.

section: PDF LoT/LoF left-column header bold-style check
question: Is the left-column header ('Table'/'Figure') in the List of Tables and List of Figures formatted in bold?
rule_definition: Conservative heuristic: detects LoT/LoF pages via detect_toc_like_pages. Requires MIN_COMPLETE_ENTRIES=3 entries with confident page-number right-x geometry. Locates the left-column header label ('Table' for LoT, 'Figure' for LoF) in the P031 header zone using _matches_left_label. If all header spans expose reliable non-bold font metadata, emits a bold-style finding. Skips pages without a detected left header (handled by P031), sparse pages, image-only pages, and pages where font metadata is unavailable or ambiguous. Findings contain style metadata only — no entry text, captions, titles, header text, or private content.
remediation: Ensure the 'Table' and 'Figure' column headers in the List of Tables and List of Figures are formatted in bold.
notes: Conservative v1 PDF heuristic for Q063 and Q072. Sections: list_of_tables, list_of_figures. Gate: requires >=3 complete entries with page_number_right_x. Uses detect_toc_like_pages, extract_toc_entry_lines, _collect_header_zone_lines, and _matches_left_label. issue_types: lot_table_header_not_bold (Q063), lof_figure_header_not_bold (Q072). Bold check skipped when font metadata unreliable. Complements P031 and P049. Left-alignment not rechecked (P031 covers coarse alignment with 80pt tolerance).
